documentation: Use Javadoc for public classes and public/protected members; include relevant @param, @return and @throws contracts.
Explain nullability, state changes and thread safety where relevant.
Omit redundant documentation for obvious accessors or accurately documented overrides.
rules: Avoid wildcard imports; use one top-level class per source file.
Use braces for conditional and loop bodies, including single statements.
Handle caught exceptions or explain intentional ignoring; preserve useful causes.
Use @Override where applicable and try-with-resources for closeable resources.
